context.content:
I've just been outside for 40 minutes _trying_ to play the game, and needless to say it was quite frustrating. I spent more time in loading screens and re-attempting to spin Poké Stops than I spent time actually playing the game. However, at least that gave me some time to come up with a few suggestions.

_Background: I'm a full-blown software engineer with ties to networking and gaming. I know what's feasible and what's not. These aren't changes that can be implemented just by flipping a single switch, but are important changes nonetheless._

I am also generalizing "server issues" to "connection issues". The server problems we're experiencing right now might be temporary, but since this is a mobile game, connection issues will always be a thing. So here we go:

* **Connection issues should never ever force me to manually restart the app.** This is kind of a no-brainer, but deserves to be part of this list. Freezes while capturing, not being able to leave the (not-loading) shop menu, having to restart the app to get onto a working server connection - all these things should never happen. I don't even care if the app kicks me back to the login-screen and starts reconnecting, as long as I don't have to manually kill the process. If your client app dies because the server does, you've made a mistake while developing it.
* **Distance traveled should be logged by the app while there is no server connection.** So instead of the app saying "I'm **here**! I'm **here**!", after a successful re-connect it should say "While we couldn't talk I was **here**, **here** and **here**". GPS inputs can already be faked (sadly), so this does not raise additional problems. This would mean that, even if you can't catch Pokémon or fight in gyms, you can at least make progress on your eggs. So trying to play the game while having connection issues does not feel like such a waste. The same should maybe go for activated Poké Stops (with the reward determined and delivered by the server as soon as there's a re-connect), but this might have more serious consequences.
* **Hatched Pokémon should appear in the journal.** I've missed hatches because of different reaons quite a few times already, and if you don't immediately notice it, it can become hard to track back which of your recent Pokémon was the one that hatched. Just put it into the journal where it belongs.
* **There should be a grace mechanic on disconnects while using timed personal items like incense and lucky eggs.** I am definitely against only letting the timer count down while the app is running, because that could be heavily exploited, but if you don't get any benefit from the item at all because you disconnect right away, the item should be replaced (and the effect stopped) or you should get at least some bonus on the timer. This one is hard to balance, but if I potentially spent real money on an item, I don't want to be in danger of not having any benefit from it.

So this is my list. What's yours?
